entries.title: Numbers 33:1
segments: ¶These are the journeys of the children of Israel, who went forth out of the land of Egypt according to their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

entries.title: Numbers 33:2
segments: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of Jehovah; and these are their journeys according to their goings out.

entries.title: Numbers 33:3
segments: They journeyed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month. On the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.

entries.title: Numbers 33:4
segments: And the Egyptians buried those whom Jehovah had smitten among them, all the firstborn; and upon their gods Jehovah executed judgments.

entries.title: Numbers 33:5
segments: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.

entries.title: Numbers 33:6
segments: And they removed from Succoth and encamped in Etham, which is at the end of the wilderness.

entries.title: Numbers 33:7
segments: And they removed from Etham, and turned back to Pi-hahiroth, which is opposite Baal-Zephon, and encamped before Migdol.

entries.title: Numbers 33:8
segments: And they removed from before Hahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days' journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:9
segments: And they removed from Marah, and came to Elim; and in Elim were twelve springs of water, and seventy palm-trees, and they encamped there.

entries.title: Numbers 33:10
segments: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.

entries.title: Numbers 33:11
segments: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.

entries.title: Numbers 33:12
segments: And they removed from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:13
segments: And they removed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.

entries.title: Numbers 33:14
segments: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.

entries.title: Numbers 33:15
segments: And they removed from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.

entries.title: Numbers 33:16
segments: And they removed from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped at Kibroth-hattaavah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:17
segments: And they removed from Kibroth-hattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.

entries.title: Numbers 33:18
segments: And they removed from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:19
segments: And they removed from Rithmah, and encamped at Rimmon-perez.

entries.title: Numbers 33:20
segments: And they removed from Rimmon-perez, and encamped in Libnah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:21
segments: And they removed from Libnah, and encamped at Rissah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:22
segments: And they removed from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:23
segments: And they removed from Kehelathah, and encamped in mount Shapher.

entries.title: Numbers 33:24
segments: And they removed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:25
segments: And they removed from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.

entries.title: Numbers 33:26
segments: And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.

entries.title: Numbers 33:27
segments: And they removed from Tahath, and encamped at Terah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:28
segments: And they removed from Terah, and encamped in Mithcah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:29
segments: And they removed from Mithcah, and encamped in Hashmonah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:30
segments: And they removed from Hashmonah, and encamped in Moseroth.

entries.title: Numbers 33:31
segments: And they removed from Moseroth, and encamped in Bene-Jaakan.

entries.title: Numbers 33:32
segments: And they removed from Bene-Jaakan, and encamped at Hor-hagidgad.

entries.title: Numbers 33:33
segments: And they removed from Hor-hagidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:34
segments: And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Abronah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:35
segments: And they removed from Abronah, and encamped at Ezion-geber.

entries.title: Numbers 33:36
segments: And they removed from Ezion-geber, and encamped in the wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.

entries.title: Numbers 33:37
segments: And they removed from Kadesh, and encamped in mount Hor, in the border of the land of Edom.

entries.title: Numbers 33:38
segments: And Aaron the priest went up mount Hor by the commandment of Jehovah, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel came out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first of the month.

entries.title: Numbers 33:39
segments: And Aaron was a hundred and twenty-three years old when he died on mount Hor.

entries.title: Numbers 33:40
segments: And the Canaanite, the king of Arad who dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.

entries.title: Numbers 33:41
segments: And they removed from mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:42
segments: And they removed from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.

entries.title: Numbers 33:43
segments: And they removed from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.

entries.title: Numbers 33:44
segments: And they removed from Oboth, and encamped in Ijim-Abarim, in the border of Moab.

entries.title: Numbers 33:45
segments: And they removed from Ijim, and encamped in Dibon-Gad.

entries.title: Numbers 33:46
segments: And they removed from Dibon-Gad, and encamped in Almon-Diblathaim.

entries.title: Numbers 33:47
segments: And they removed from Almon-Diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

entries.title: Numbers 33:48
segments: And they removed from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan of Jericho.

entries.title: Numbers 33:49
segments: And they encamped by the Jordan, from Beth-jeshimoth unto Abel-Shittim, in the plains of Moab.

entries.title: Numbers 33:50
segments: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan of Jericho, saying,

entries.title: Numbers 33:51
segments: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye pass over Jordan into the land of Canaan,

entries.title: Numbers 33:52
segments: then ye shall dispossess all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and ye shall destroy all their figured images, and all their molten images shall ye destroy, and all their high places shall ye lay waste;

entries.title: Numbers 33:53
segments: and ye shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein, for to you have I given the land to possess it.

entries.title: Numbers 33:54
segments: And ye shall take for yourselves the land as an inheritance by lot according to your families: to the many ye shall increase their inheritance, and to the few thou shalt diminish their inheritance: where the lot falleth to him, there shall be each man's [inheritance]; according to the tribes of your fathers shall ye take for yourselves the inheritance.

entries.title: Numbers 33:55
segments: But if ye will not dispossess the inhabitants of the land from before you, those that ye let remain of them shall be thorns in your eyes, and pricks in your sides, and they shall harass you in the land wherein ye dwell.

entries.title: Numbers 33:56
segments: And it shall come to pass that I will do unto you as I thought to do unto them.
